convert_detr_checkpoint: convert a Facebook DETR checkpoint to HuggingFace PyTorch format and save to a directory
rename_backbone_keys: rename backbone state dict keys from timm format to HuggingFace conv_encoder format
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated query-key-value projections into separate q_proj, k_proj, v_proj layers
run_detr_conversion_cli: run the DETR checkpoint conversion CLI with model name and output directory arguments
verify_detr_conversion: verify converted DETR model outputs match the original checkpoint within tolerance
